whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Khatta Meetha Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.2★ reviews with 200+ happy diners in Mahesh Nagar, but lacked a dedicated mobile menu and online table/order booking page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special menu showcase, aur instant table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/khattameetha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Khatta Meetha Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Khatta Meetha Restaurant Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly menu, direct WhatsApp ordering, and your 4.2-star ratings highlighted for Mahesh Nagar diners. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual food photography aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
